nav.signOutConfirmBody: You'll need to sign in again to access the management console.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: Manage admin security and your current session.
settings.staffProtectionDescription: Require staff credentials and manager approval for case creation and lifecycle changes.
settings.managerIncorrect: The manager password is incorrect. Nothing was changed.
settings.enableWarning: Enter the manager password to restore staff confirmation protection.
settings.disableWarning: While disabled, case creation and lifecycle changes will not ask for staff or manager credentials.
settings.loadFailed: Security settings could not be loaded. Protection remains enabled.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.subtitle: Overview of all lab cases and their current status.
dashboard.noCasesBody: Create the first case and it will appear here for quick access.

login.title: Admin Sign In
login.errorRateLimited: Too many attempts. Please wait a few minutes and try again.
login.errorUnavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again shortly.

cases.searchPlaceholder: Search patient, doctor or case type...
cases.noCasesHint: Try adjusting your search, status, or category filters.
cases.deleteBody: This permanently removes the case, its progress steps and images. This cannot be undone.

detail.allStagesHidden: All stages are hidden. Show at least one below.
detail.buildTimeline: Select a collection above to build this case's stage timeline.
detail.hideStage: Hide this stage for this case
detail.hiddenStagesNote: Hidden stages don't appear in the case timeline (admin or public).
detail.deleteBody: This permanently removes the case, its progress steps and images.

form.newDesc: Create a case when it arrives at the lab.
form.noWorkflowForType: No {type} workflow available for this group
form.workflowRequired: A workflow is required for this category.
form.receivedByLocked: Set when the case was created and cannot be changed.
form.pickCollection: Pick a production collection (can set later)
form.createdDesc: Share this tracking ID with the doctor for public case tracking.

progress.title: Production Steps
progress.desc: Steps are logged per stage. Pick a stage to view and add its steps — doctors see each stage's steps when they open that stage.
progress.noChips: No quick-add steps for this stage yet. Add one with the form below.
progress.chooseStageChips: Choose a collection and stage for this case to see stage-specific quick-add steps.
progress.noStepsStage: No steps for this stage yet. Add one below or use a quick-add chip.
progress.chooseStageSteps: Choose a collection and stage to start logging steps.
progress.chooseStageAdd: Select a collection and stage for this case to add production steps.
progress.editChipDesc: Renaming updates this chip for every case using this collection & stage. Steps already logged on cases keep their original text.
progress.removeChipDesc: It disappears from the quick-add list for this collection & stage. Steps already logged on cases are not affected.
progress.toastLabelsRequired: Both English and Arabic labels are required

image.title: Case Images
image.hint: PNG, JPG, WebP or AVIF — up to 15MB each. New uploads are tagged to the current stage:

portfolio.title: Portfolio
portfolio.subtitle: Manage the Our Work showcase — items, photos, and folders.
portfolio.foldersDesc: Rename, reorder, add, or remove the Our Work folders.
portfolio.folderDeleteBlocked: This folder still has cases. Move or delete them first.
portfolio.emptyFolder: No items in this folder yet.
portfolio.confirmDeleteBody: This permanently removes the item and its photos. This cannot be undone.
portfolio.newDesc: Add a showcased case with bilingual copy and photos.
portfolio.editDesc: Update this case's folder, copy, and photos.
portfolio.toastError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

groups.title: Case Workflows
groups.subtitle: Manage the groups, their Regular/Digital workflows, and production stages.
groups.deleteWorkflowBlocked: Move its cases and delete its stages first
groups.deleteStageBlocked: In use by live cases — can't delete
groups.toastError: Something went wrong. Please try again.

confirm.title: Confirmation required
confirm.desc: This action changes a case's lifecycle and must be approved.
confirm.staffRequired: Select your name and enter your PIN.
confirm.singleFactorNotice: Single-factor approval — as the manager, this one code authorises the action by itself. No separate staff PIN is required, and the audit log records it as a single-factor approval.
confirm.managerSelfHint: Enter the manager code to approve this action.
confirm.managerHint: Ask the manager to enter the code to approve this action.

stageView.desc: Read-only view. Nothing here changes the case.
stageView.notRecorded: Not recorded — this stage was entered before stage history was tracked.
stageView.legacyCaseNote: This case has no recorded stage history: its transitions happened before tracking was introduced. Timestamps will appear for transitions made from now on.
stageView.noSteps: No steps logged for this stage.
stageView.noImages: No images tagged to this stage.
stageView.readOnlyNote: Viewing only — to move the case to this stage, use the stage picker or the stepper (both require confirmation).

staff.title: Staff
staff.subtitle: Manage staff confirmation PINs and the PRIMARY manager PIN.
staff.gateDescription: Enter the current PRIMARY manager PIN to open Staff Management. Access expires automatically after 10 minutes.
staff.managerIncorrect: The manager PIN is incorrect. Access was not granted.
staff.loadFailed: Staff Management could not be loaded or access expired.
staff.managerSecretsDescription: Credential records are shown as metadata only. Hashes and plaintext values are never returned.
staff.addDescription: Create a staff PIN used only for protected admin confirmations.
staff.name: Name
staff.passwordBlankHint: Leave blank to keep the current PIN. New PINs must contain at least 6 digits.
staff.editDescription: Rename the staff member, reset their PIN, or change their status.
staff.managerMustStayActive: The current manager must remain active.
staff.deactivateHint: Deactivation preserves audit history and prevents future confirmations.
staff.changePrimaryDescription: Confirm the current manager PIN, then set a new PIN. All Staff Management sessions will be locked.
staff.secretUpdatedToast: PRIMARY manager PIN updated. Staff Management was locked.

caseHistory.title: Stage history
caseHistory.subtitle: {name} · created {date}
caseHistory.loadError: Could not load this case's history.
caseHistory.noWorkflow: No workflow has been selected for this case yet, so it has no stages to track.
caseHistory.readOnlyNote: Viewing only — open the case to make changes.

doctors.title: Doctors
doctors.subtitle: Roster of referring doctors and their portal codes.
doctors.addDesc: The code is issued automatically and cannot be changed afterwards.
doctors.empty: No doctors yet. Add the first one to issue a portal code.
doctors.name: Doctor name
doctors.lettersHint: 3 Latin letters, auto-suggested from the name. Edit if the transliteration looks wrong.
doctors.codePreviewNote: The last 4 characters are generated randomly when you save.
doctors.codeImmutable: The code and its number are fixed once issued — cases and anything already shared depend on them. Use Rotate to reissue.
doctors.editDesc: Rename or deactivate. The code cannot be changed here.
doctors.deleteWithCases: {name} is linked to {count} case(s). Deleting removes the roster entry only — those cases are KEPT and keep their doctor name, they just become unlinked.
doctors.deleteNoCases: {name} has no linked cases. This removes the roster entry.
doctors.rotateDesc: A new random suffix is generated. The current code ({code}) STOPS WORKING immediately — the doctor must be given the new one.
doctors.toastDeletedWithCases: Doctor deleted — {count} case(s) unlinked, none removed

doctorPick.noMatch: No roster match — will be saved as typed
doctorPick.useAsTyped: Use "{name}" as a one-off (not on the roster)
doctorPick.linkedHint: Linked to the roster — this case will appear in that doctor's portal.
doctorPick.freeHint: Pick from the roster, or type any name for a one-off doctor.
doctorPick.linkHint: Linking makes this case appear in that doctor's portal. The doctor name above is kept as recorded and is not overwritten.
